supersedes_note: This is a distinct freeze event from healthcare-demo-new-source-corpus-v1.0.0.freeze-manifest.json (2026-07-27, PR #5676), which pinned the 72-file design/template corpus under clients/healthcare-demo-new/19-template-instantiation-source-corpus/. This freeze pins the actual instantiated data — the consolidated universal one-file-per-domain packet (Universal Tenant Input Standard v3) generated from that design corpus — landing at datasets/tenant-inputs/active/healthcare-demo-new/current/ for the first time. The 2026-07-27 manifest is not superseded or invalidated; it remains the design-layer freeze this data instantiation was built from.

approval_authority.approval_scope: Phase 0 freeze only — pin the remediated healthcare-demo-new instantiated dataset as the source package for a future Foundation V2 candidacy. Does not authorize Phase 1 Azure infrastructure, source landing, parser execution, publication, or product runtime wiring.

package_note: Consolidated universal one-file-per-domain packet (Universal Tenant Input Standard v3), instantiated against the Phase-0 design corpus in clients/healthcare-demo-new/19-template-instantiation-source-corpus/. The registry's canonicalInputRoot already declared this path before this freeze; this manifest is the first freeze pin against real files landing there.

semantic_audit.notes: Every USABLE_WITH_LIMITATIONS finding is named and specific, not unexplained or silently accepted: 01_business_functions has one always-empty column (parent_function); 04_applications_systems, 06_infrastructure_platforms, 12_relationships, and 14_metrics_outcomes each have one field where a real recurring phrase (a shared hosting location, platform name, or data-source description that legitimately repeats across related rows) crosses the phrase-diversity threshold; 15_industry_context_patterns' single industry-classification phrase is repeated across all 12 rows by construction, since every row describes the same tenant's industry segment. None are filler text or unexplained repetition — this exceeds skyharbor-air's own frozen bar (14/26 PRODUCT_USABLE, 54%) at 18/24 (75%).

hidden_truth.note: A restricted-evaluator hidden-truth/crosswalk package exists for the original 2026-07-27 design corpus (clients/healthcare-demo-new/19-template-instantiation-source-corpus/04-restricted-evaluator-design/). Whether it applies unmodified to this instantiated packet or needs its own regeneration against the new file shapes has not been checked as part of this freeze — a real open question, not assumed either way.

phase_1_zero_data_authority.note: No Azure resource group, Postgres server, storage account, or managed identity exists for healthcare-demo-new. Provisioning requires a separate, explicit go-ahead beyond this freeze, consistent with skyharbor-air's Phase 0/Phase 1 separation.
